title: Frontiers: Inequalities in Dealers’ Interest Rate Markups? A Gender- and Race-Based Analysis
authors: O. Cem Ozturk; Cheng He; Pradeep K. Chintagunta
eligible_reason: Not a DiD. Transaction-level cross-sectional regressions of the dealer interest-rate markup on buyer gender (female) and neighborhood minority share with about 25 transaction and demographic controls and vehicle-model, dealer, year-week and buyer-zip FE (Tables 2-4, Figures 2-3). The regressors of interest are buyer characteristics, not a treatment that switches on over time.
design_notes: Stata final_code.do, single file. reghdfe markup female i.minority_grp ... , absorb(INDEX TRANSMISSION FUELTYPE ...) cluster(RETAILERID); INDEX is a four-way FE (vehicle model, dealer, year-week, buyer zip). Table 4 interacts female and minority_grp with moderators; Figure 2 interacts them with state.

ineligible_specs_listed.reason: cross-sectional gender/race gap regressions with controls; no switching treatment
gender/minority x moderator or x state interactions

data_files_note: README: proprietary transaction data from a marketing agency (2004-2015); only a subsample is provided (112,529 transactions shipped), merged with ACS and county vote data.
data_provenance_note: README says 'we only provide a subsample of this dataset'; sampling scheme not described.
screener_notes: Screened from package and OpenAlex metadata (no article text). No panel treatment timing at all.
